Package de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater.lynaupdater

Class LynaUpdateChecker

java.lang.Object
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater.Updater<LynaUpdateResponse,LynaUpdateData>
de.eldoria.eldoutilities.updater.lynaupdater.LynaUpdateChecker
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, Listener
public class LynaUpdateChecker extends Updater<LynaUpdateResponse,LynaUpdateData>
Update checks against a Lyna instance. Query values are URL encoded and a check gives up after 10 seconds.

Only stable releases within the installed major version are installed automatically; a new major version needs a confirmed download. The download button offers stable releases, and dev or snapshot builds only to a server already running a dev or snapshot build.

A free product is downloaded from the public address the update check answers with. A premium product trades the upgrade token of its UpgradeTokenStore at /api/v1/update/token for a short-lived download address and the next token, which is stored before the download starts. Downloads go into the server's update folder under the name of the running plugin file, where the server picks them up on the next start.

Since:
1.1.0
